# Support

Issues for every public EzClassify repository are tracked in one place: the
umbrella repository at
[github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify](https://github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify).
Individual repos have their Issues tab disabled so that bug reports, feature
requests, and questions all land in the same tracker.

## Where to go

- **Bug reports and feature requests:**
  [open an issue](https://github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify/issues) on the
  umbrella repository. Mention which repo and version you are using.
- **Questions and general discussion:**
  [start a discussion](https://github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify/discussions).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** do not open a public issue. Follow the
  disclosure process in the affected repository's `SECURITY.md`, or email
  security@ezclassify.com.

## Before you file

- Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify/issues)
  and [discussions](https://github.com/ezclassify/ezclassify/discussions) first.
- Include the repository name, the version, and steps to reproduce.
